requirements.rule: Art. 9 (Sez. IV Tit. III): the holidays of letters b and c in a sickness or a work injury reach 100% (sickness_rules.holiday and insured_absence.injury.holiday). Not calculated: the holiday top-up during pregnancy and puerperium, the patron saint substitute and 29 June, a letter b holiday in Rome only, outside the national calendar.
requirements.remediation: Top up pregnancy and puerperium holidays, the substitute patron holiday and Rome-only 29 June when the applicable local facts are stated.

requirements.rule: LEAVE, PAR (Sez. Quarta, Titolo III, Art. 5, renewal of 22 November 2025 p. 33): the settore siderurgico (EmployerProfile.subsector steel) accrues 124 hours in place of 104, and the turnisti on 15 or more weekly shifts including the night shift (Employment.qualifying_shifts) 8 hours more. Not modelled: the 8 hours of the siderurgico turnisti, paid with the 13th; the further 4 hours from 2027 at 18 or more weekly shifts and 4 more from 2028 at 21 for the non siderurgico workers; and the hour of the sottosettori of the accordo of 16 July 1979 for the workers in service at 31 December 2012.
requirements.remediation: Add employment facts for 18 and 21 weekly shifts with night work and for the historical sottosettore, accrue their hours, and pay the siderurgico shift hours with the 13th.
